steps.title: 选入书评，还是写进书评？

config.body: Reading 2 讨论了哪些书获得评论，以及评论怎样描述这些书。先在手边教材各找一句能指向这两个问题的原文。

steps.title: 看看模拟编辑台的两份材料

config.body: Fictional editorial desk · Sheet A lists which titles were selected for the review section. Sheet B contains the written reviews of the selected titles.
config.prompt: For each sheet, tell a partner one question it could help you answer.

config.body: You want to know whether reviews describe two sets of books using different words.

options.label: Which book titles were selected for review.
Words in the written reviews for the two sets of books.
How many copies of each book were sold.

teacher.note: 同桌各说一句理由。揭晓后让同学解释另一份材料适合回答什么问题。
teacher.explanation: The question concerns descriptions, so compare the wording of the reviews. A list of titles can help you ask which books received coverage.

steps.title: 换一个问题，证据也要换吗？
steps.fallback: 模拟编辑台有两份材料：一张记录获评书名的清单，一叠书评原文。同桌各用一份材料提一个研究问题，再交换问题，判断手中的材料能不能回答对方。

config.prompt: For the question …, I would compare … because … .
